Our Menu & Prices… At De Vette Mossel, most of our dishes are prepared right in front of you on open fires , adding to the magic of the experience. Our menu offers a feast like no other – 7 courses, 13 dishes, served rolling buffet style. 1. Freshly baked Pot brood (pot bread) served with farm butter and sweet apricot jam 2. Mussel meat with onions, lots of garlic and farm butter 3. Mussels in half shell steamed with onions & white wine 4. West Coast Snoek with Sweet sweet potato – West Coast style 5. Seafood pot with 3 types of fish calamari strips, mussels and prawn tails Rice: for those who want to catch the sauce Garden salad: we seldom talk about salads Vegetable dish with milk and cheese: even Karoo farmers tuck in 6. Meat potjie (for those who don’t eat seafood) 7. Water Melon and Sweet Melon or Tropical Fruit (slides down your throat) 8. Coffee and Koeksisters with South African Rooibos tea Additional: Catch of the Day prepared with onions and butter & oil Calamari Steak pan fried with onions and butter (this is how it should taste) West Coast Rock Lobster/Whole Prawns – taste the sea! Oysters -the ocean’s pearl Prices: R395 Per adult R310 Per high-school child R180 Per primary-school child R70 Per pre-school child R0 3 years and under Additional extras on request: Kreef (lobster): R390 for 330g Whole prawns: R250 for 400g Calamari steak: R90 for 170g Catch of the day: R90 for 170g Oysters: R150 for 5 NOTE: Prices are subject to change. Cash bar available and card facilities are provided. (Tariffs are subject to change, once a year on 1 December.) Show me the "more detailed" version... Beware of our famous Potbrood! Oooeee Delliah – Yes, you have been warned! We bake our very own pot brood (pot bread) over the fire. It is impossible to resist, especially when served with farm butter and sweet apricot jam (appelkooskonfyt)! But be careful, because when your mussels arrive and you see the seafood pot bubbling away, you might shed a tear if you have filled up on bread! The pot bread is followed by tender mussel meat , sautéed with onions, heaps of garlic and farm butter, alongside mussels in half shells steamed in white wine and onions, all served to your table. The next dish is a West Coast classic: snoek served with sweet West Coast style sweet potatoes . Next, indulge in our signature seafood pot , packed with 3 types of fish , calamari strips , mussels and prawn tails served with savoury rice , a garden salad and a rich vegetable dish with milk and cheese . For those who prefer meat, there is a hearty meat pot . To top it all off, we end your dining experience with seasonal fresh fruit , traditional South African moer coffee , rooibos tea with condensed milk and a delightful local favourite – koeksisters ! This is a feast that lasts nearly three hours, so sit back, relax and enjoy – and if anything runs low, don’t worry, there is always more on the way! Book your experience The DVM-Grootbrak story… Niël du Bois the visionary behind the De Vette Mossel, opened De Vette Mossel Grootbrak (Mossel Bay) in 2004. This new and unique beach seafood experience quickly captured the hearts of guests, thanks to the support of our beloved “Mossel-friends”. Before long De Vette Mossel Grootbrak had become a sought-after destination for those craving something truly different and extraordinary. As the original Mossel, its success paved the way for three more branches, with the fourth proudly opening in Hermanus by 2018. A key to the success of this Mossel is Nikki Geyer . Her warm, welcoming and ever-helpful nature makes her an integral part of the team. Nothing is ever too much for her, and her dedication is felt in every detail of the experience she helps create. At De Vette Mossel, we are committed to uplifting our community. That is why we have chosen to employ individuals who were previously unemployed, providing them with the necessary training and skills. Today, they are valued members of our Mossel-family, sharing not only in the hard work, but also in the success of the Mossel. With Nikki’s passion and her team’s dedication, you are sure to experience the signature beach/ island style vibe and seafood feast that De Vette Mossel is renowned for. Each visit guarantees the same unforgettable experience, concept and menu that you have come to love at every De Vette Mossel. Book your experience! “One of the greatest eating experiences I have ever had! The food is amazing, vibe is vintage beach side Village, and the event is truly unique.” ★★★★★ Robbie Catanho We are SASSI Green!* *except prawns & rock lobster, which are additional and not part of the buffet menu. At De Vette Mossel Grootbrak, we are deeply committed to sustainability and minimizing our impact on the environment. We grow some of our own vegetables using compost from our garden and encourage suppliers to source less plastic packaging. Our seafood is sourced responsibly and we make every effort to use local ingredients. We proudly repurpose recycled materials, like fishing nets and ‘fluitjie’ reeds, for building. By using minimal water and donating leftover food to the local community, we ensure that nothing goes to waste. We donate all food that could not be finished to families in serious need within the community. Nothing goes to waste here. Prices are R440 for adults, R390 for pensioners, R310 for high school learners, R180 for primary school learners and R70 for preschoolers, with a full seafood feast included. Heritage Day is getting a suitably South African seafood treatment at De Vette Mossel Grootbrak, where the famous rolling buffet is bringing a particularly tempting addition to the table: prawns that guests can enjoy as much as they like. Taking place on Thursday, 24 September 2026 from 12:00, the Heritage Day celebration is built around the venue’s beachside seafood experience , with a generous spread moving through the meal in classic De Vette Mossel style. What is included in the Heritage Day seafood buffet? The Heritage Day Prawn Menu starts with freshly baked pot bread served with farm butter and jam, followed by mussel meat with onions, garlic and butter and mussels in the half shell steamed in white wine with onions. The seafood feast continues with West Coast snoek and traditional sweet potatoes, followed by a seafood pot containing three types of fish, calamari strips and prawn tails. There is also a meat pot, along with a vegetable dish with milk and cheese, flavoured rice and garden salad. And then comes the main attraction for prawn fans: all-you-can-eat prawns. To finish, the buffet includes seasonal fruit, followed by coffee or rooibos tea and koeksisters. Extras are available on request. De Vette Mossel Grootbrak is known for its rolling buffet format, with the venue describing its standard experience as seven courses and 13 dishes. Most dishes are prepared over open fires, adding to the relaxed beachside character of the meal. The Heritage Day pricing is structured across different age groups, making it a family-friendly celebration: Adults: R440 per person Pensioners: R390 per person High school: R310 per person Primary school: R180 per person Preschool: R70 per person With West Coast snoek, mussels, seafood pot, pot bread, koeksisters and, of course, all-you-can-eat prawns, De Vette Mossel Grootbrak’s Heritage Day celebration gives seafood lovers plenty of reason to arrive hungry. The venue is located right on the beach between Klein- and Groot Brakrivier near Mossel Bay in the Garden Route, giving the Heritage Day gathering a distinctly coastal setting. Bookings are essential. Guests can reserve online at https://account.dineplan.com/widgetframe/KrNQjPXp, or contact De Vette Mossel Grootbrak directly on 079 339 0170 by phone or WhatsApp, or email grootbrak@devettemossel.co.za. With panoramic ocean views, warm hospitality, and a passion for fine food, art, and nature, we invite you to escape, explore, and indulge in the beauty of South Africa’s southern coast. Whether you’re enjoying a leisurely breakfast, a long lunch, or a sunset drink, every bite is accompanied by stunning ocean views. Sip & Unwind Discover the perfect pour at our wine and gin bar , offering a curated selection of South Africa’s finest wines, craft beers, and artisanal gins. Gallery Back to all events Calendar View Atlantic Rail Trip Event Information THE COAST BY STEAM There’s something truly special about seeing SYLVIA steaming along the Mossel Bay coastline and you can experience it from aboard the train! Climb aboard our beautifully restored vintage coaches and enjoy a nostalgic steam journey between Hartenbos and Santos, Mossel Bay, with spectacular coastal views along the way. 🎟️ CHOOSE YOUR EXPERIENCE: 🚋 Passenger Coach — R195 per person 🏰 Private Compartment — R1 500 Seats up to 6 people ✨ Private Coupé — R750 Seats up to 3 people ☕ Café Lounge — R300 per person 🍷 Bar Lounge — R350 per person 👶 Children under 3 travel FREE! Bring the family, bring the camera and come experience the timeless charm of steam travel along one of the Garden Route’s most beautiful stretches of railway. ❤️🚂 🎟️ Book your tickets online: scrail.co.za The coast. The steam. The memories. Ideal for Perfect for car and motorcycle enthusiasts, families, friends, automotive fans, classic and performance vehicle lovers, and anyone looking to enjoy a relaxed day of cars, coffee, food, music and entertainment beside the beautiful Hartenbos seafront. Coffee & Cars SA presents OUTENIQUA 2026, a brand-new automotive event coming to Hartenbos in the Garden Route. Hosted by ATKV-Hartenbos, this exciting day brings together an impressive collection of cars, motorcycles, automotive enthusiasts and lifestyle experiences against the beautiful backdrop of the Southern Cape coastline. Whether you’re passionate about performance cars, classic vehicles, muscle cars, JDM and European models, superbikes or custom motorcycles, OUTENIQUA 2026 offers something for every motoring enthusiast. Visitors can enjoy a relaxed day at the Hartenbos seafront with exceptional vehicles, food and lifestyle vendors, music, entertainment and a family-friendly atmosphere. Kom beleef nou die rykdom van dié besondere musiekerfenis soos Jannie dit met sy kenmerkende passie na die verhoog toe bring. Hy het sy programkeuse op grond van jeugherinneringe, persoonlike verbintenis en artistieke waarde gemaak: liedjies van o.a. Emiel Hullebroeck, Danie Bosman, Marie Tredoux, Jan Pohl en tradisionele liedjies met ’n besondere digterlike kwaliteit en musikale sintese. Nadat sy Holland's Got Talent in 2013, op net negejarige ouderdom gewen het, het Amira harte wêreldwyd verower. Sedertdien het sy die wêreld vol getoer en saam met vele internasionale kunstenaars, insluitende André Rieu, opgetree. Hierdie jong selfgeleerde wonderkind het tot ’n gerekende en erkende internasionale klassieke- en crossover sangeres ontwikkel. Amira betower die gehoor met haar sprankelende verhoogpersoonlikheid en onmiskenbare verhoogcharisma en die gehoor kan uitsien na ‘n meesterlike, magiese, musikale kragtoer met ‘n musieksamestelling wat bekend op die oor val. Haar inspirerende repertoire weef tydlose klassieke meesterstukke, gunsteling kontemporêre klanke, geliefde musiek uit musiekblyspele en uit-die-hart Afrikaanse musiek naatloos saam. Moenie hierdie wêreldklas onvergeetlike musiekervaring misloop nie. Your Garden Route Event Guide - 8 October Home Submit Event Advertise Contact Us Sign in Subscribe Your Garden Route Event Guide - 8 October Justin 08 Oct 2026 — 9 min read Share ‎⁨Coney Glen Beach⁩, ⁨Knysna⁩ Highlights this week include Hemelruim's first desert disco in Oudtshoorn, the tenth Garden Route Kite Festival in Sedgefield, the Fancourt Marathon in George, the Topper Nationals in Mossel Bay and the Plett Games. Not subscribed yet? Sign up below for your free weekly garden route event guide Subscribe Email sent! Check your inbox to complete your signup. No spam. Unsubscribe anytime. Mossel Bay Tanja Storm: Ballads and Blues Tanja Storm performs an evening of ballads and blues with guest Blackie Swart at this Little Brak River music venue. Date:  Wednesday 7 October Time:  19:00 Venue:  Blou Kombuis, 2nd Avenue, Little Brak River, Mossel Bay Moss March A community walk with purpose on the Hartenbos seafront, part of the Mossel Bay Sport and Recreation Festival. Entry is free; walkers are asked to bring tinned or non-perishable food and socks for those in need. Strongman and powerlifting competitions follow at the same venue. Date:  Saturday 10 October Time:  07:00 to 09:00 Venue:  Hartenbos Seefront, 156 Paardekraal Avenue, Hartenbos, Mossel Bay Garden Route Armwrestling Tournament A double-elimination showdown open to first-timers and seasoned pullers alike. Entry is R100 for one arm or R150 for both, and spectator tickets cost R100. Date:  Saturday 10 October Time:  Registration and weigh-ins from 08:30, tournament from 10:00 Venue:  Mooiuitsig Restaurant, Brinkley's River Village, 1 Old George Road, Klein Brak River, Mossel Bay Misty Valley Oktoberfest The farm's second Oktoberfest runs every Saturday in October with craft beer, food and live music. Entrance is free and the day is cashless. Date:  Saturday 10 October and Saturday 17 October Time:  09:00 to 18:00 Venue:  Misty Valley Farm, R328, Brandwacht, Mossel Bay Jo Black Live at ReedValley An evening of Afrikaans music from Jo Black on the wine estate, with ReedValley wines and food on sale. Tickets start at R220. Date:  Saturday 10 October Time:  20:00 Venue:  ReedValley Farm, R327, Mossel Bay Magnificent Movie Music Carpe Musicam brings its programme of orchestral and choral film favourites to the Town Hall for a 90-minute Sunday afternoon concert, with violinist Marie-Jean Kotzé as soloist. Tickets cost R180 for adults and R60 for scholars from carpemusicam.co.za. Date:  Sunday 11 October Time:  15:30 Venue:  Mossel Bay Town Hall, 101 Marsh Street, Mossel Bay Song Sung Blue at The Blue Shed Open Plan Pictures screens Song Sung Blue, the story of two down-on-their-luck performers who form a Neil Diamond tribute act, as part of its spring movie series. Tickets start at R100. Date:  Friday 16 October Time:  19:00 Venue:  The Blue Shed, 33 Bland Street, Mossel Bay Topper Nationals Mossel Bay Sailing Club and the Skipper Foundation host the national championship for the Topper dinghy class. Spectators are welcome on the beach to watch young sailors race in the bay. that shaped our farms, our families and our South African stories. It’s the kind of experience that wakes up your inner 12-year-old… the one who still wants to shout “Start her up!” and hit the gravel running. Everyone is welcome — vrouens, kinders, tannies, ooms, die hele span. This is a family event with a warm Garden Route heartbeat. Camping at Bartelsfontein Farm bring families into the lively spirit of the Rattle and Rust Rally. Between them they play more than 8 musical instruments and have over 80 years experience of professional musical performances. “We see it as our joyful duty to pass on our knowledge to anyone who is interested in | improving their musical skills.” Elsabe Barkhuizen Elsabe is a very experienced and sought-after church organist, pianist and harpsichordist who has been playing professionally since the age of 12. Until 2016 she held the post of Director of Music for the Dutch Reformed Church’s Mother Parish in George, South Africa. Her “home” organ was a historic 1879 William Hill of London mechanical pipe-organ. She’s also the co-founder/resident pianist/organist of the Carpe Musicam! Orchestra, a community-based orchestra in the Garden Route. Norman Carless Norman has had a long and successful career in South African military bands and orchestras, being a Bandmaster for the South African Navy before his retirement in 2003. He is a conductor and multi-instrumentalist, performing regularly on the Trumpet, Cornet, Flute, Recorder and the French Horn. He is also a Master Arranger and Orchestrator, specialising in custom orchestrations of popular works for unusual groupings of instruments. In July 2015 he co-founded the Carpe Musicam! Orchestra, which has grown very quickly and is rapidly becoming a force to be reckoned with. “Seize the Music!” Gallery We are Performing again soon! SA Nationals Criterium 2026 – Mossel Bay – Eden Cycling Association Home About News Results Events Contact SA Nationals Criterium 2026 – Mossel Bay Home Events News Calendar SA Nationals Criterium 2026 – Mossel Bay SA Nationals Criterium 2026 – Mossel Bay July 1, 2026 By [email protected] In Calendar , Events , News No Comments National Criterium Championships Come to Mossel Bay Mossel Bay will welcome cyclists from across South Africa for the 2026 South African National Criterium Championships on 31 October and 1 November . Hosted by Eden Cycling and organised by Crank To Crown Events in partnership with Cycling South Africa, the championships promise an exciting weekend of coastal racing as riders compete for the national champion’s jersey. The approximately 3.5 km circuit along George Road in the De Bakke–Santos area offers fast racing on smooth tar, with a fully closed circuit and a race village at Santos Beach. Spectators can enjoy the action as riders pass repeatedly throughout each race. Saturday features Veterans and Masters racing, together with the C2C Youth Criterium Championships . Young cyclists will experience the same circuit as the national competitors, with mountain bikes welcome in the youth event. Junior, Under 23 and Elite riders race on Sunday. The weekend begins with a community outride on Friday, 30 October , starting at Diaz Hotel. Registration, the official opening ceremony and prize givings will also take place at Diaz Hotel & Resort , the official accommodation partner. Following the relocation from George, we thank Mossel Bay Municipality, our partners and the cycling community for their support in bringing these championships to life. Bring your bike, bring your family and join us in Mossel Bay! Online entries close 27 October , with late entries available at registration on 30 October . National championship riders must meet Cycling South Africa’s eligibility and racing-licence requirements. Please consult the event guide for the full programme, registration times, route maps, parking and accommodation information. Gallery Back to all events Calendar View Saturday Market at Johnson’s Post Event Information Join us for the next Saturday Market at Johnson’s Post, a family legacy store nestled along a scenic Garden Route meander between Vleesbaai and Gouritsmond. A firm favourite with locals and travellers alike, Johnson’s Post is known for its warm hospitality, relaxed country atmosphere, and authentic taste of the region. Browse the market stalls while enjoying quality coffee, cakes, snacks, and locally loved baked delicacies. Market favourites include pancakes, wors, vleis, fresh juices, gifts, and a variety of shopping stalls — perfect for a leisurely morning out. Johnson’s Post is a popular stopover for cyclists, bikers, and scenic Sunday drivers, making it an ideal weekend outing for families and friends looking to unwind and enjoy the countryside. Special market days and other events will be posted on our Facebook and Google Business page, follow us on Facebook and Instagram to keep up to date with our events. 🕗 Time: From 08:00 A great stop, great food, and a great way to start your Saturday. Gallery Back to all events Calendar View Kaia Market Collective Event Information Join us at Market Café in Mossel Bay for our Monthly Makers Market — a relaxed celebration of local creativity, community, good food and all things handmade. Discover a carefully curated mix of local makers, talented creatives, artisanal products and fresh, locally sourced produce. From unique handmade treasures and thoughtful gifts to delicious treats and beautiful finds, there’s plenty to browse, discover and take home. Take your time exploring the market while enjoying fresh food, drinks and great coffee from Market Café. Soak up the atmosphere with live music, bring the kids along for some family-friendly fun, and enjoy a laid-back day out with friends and loved ones. Whether you’re looking to support local small businesses, discover something new, enjoy a bite to eat, or simply spend a few hours in a vibrant community atmosphere, the Monthly Makers Market is the perfect place to do it. Come shop local, eat well, meet the makers and enjoy the weekend with us — and keep an eye out for a few surprises in store! Daar gebeur soveel dinge, en namate ons lewenspad ontvou, versamel ons allerlei dinge langs die pad. Sommige daarvan is kosbaar en verryk ons menswees, terwyl ander ’n swaar las word wat ons soms onbewustelik met ons saamdra. Tydens hierdie eendagkonferensie gesels ons juis hieroor – oor jou lewe, jou lewensreis en alles wat jy mettertyd in jou boksie versamel het. Ons ontdek saam waarom dit so belangrik is om God in jou boksie toe te laat, ruimte vir sy teenwoordigheid te skep en jou hart al hoe wyer vir sy Koninkryk oop te maak. ???? LET WEL: Hierdie eendagkonferensie is vir BEIDE MANS EN DAMES. Vier inspirerende lesings wat jou hart sal aanraak en jou lewe sal verryk. Geesvervulde lofprysing en aanbidding, Heerlike verversings en middagete, ’n Notaboekie, ’n Spesiale geskenkpakkie en nog soveel meer. Dit alles in ’n besondere omgewing waar jy hartlik verwelkom word, tuis kan voel en weet dat jy waardevol is. Kom ontdek opnuut wat gebeur wanneer jy jou lewe in God se hand plaas. Gallery Back to all events Calendar View FLOURISH – An Inspiring Event for Women Event Information FLOURISH – An Inspiring Event for Women CONNECT • LEARN • GROW • THRIVE Join us for FLOURISH, an inspiring and unique event created for women who want to invest in themselves and explore the different dimensions of a thriving life. This special event brings together three presenters who will share their expertise through interactive workshops focused on finance, wellness and confidence. Discover three perspectives on flourishing: * FUN WITH FINANCE – Angelique: Senior Financial Wellness Advisor: Explore your relationship with money and discover practical and meaningful principles for financial wellbeing. * WELLNESS MATTERS – Alma: Counselling, Consulting & Wellness. Develop a greater understanding of how to nurture and strengthen your overall wellbeing. * CONFIDENCE MATTERS – Isabella: Confidence Transformation Coach. The way you see yourself shapes the way you show up – Moving beyond self-doubt and reconnecting with your confidence. The event is designed around small-group workshops, giving every participant the opportunity to experience all three sessions, reflect on new insights and connect with other women in a welcoming setting. With ONLY 12 PLACES AVAILABLE, FLOURISH offers a personal experience focused on learning, connection and growth. A light lunch and refreshments are included. Event Details: Cost: R350 per person Bookings: Contact 060 147 5994 Booking deadline: 1 November 2026 Places are limited, and payment secures your booking. Come connect, learn, grow and flourish together at FLOURISH – an inspiring experience celebrating the many dimensions of a thriving life. Stay informed about our upcoming events by following us on our website and social media channels. Make Christmas afternoon a feast to remember! Gather your favourite people and celebrate at Santos Express Train Lodge with a festive buffet full of Christmas favourites and something for every appetite. Christmas Day | 25 December 2026 Seating at 3:00 p.m. Fill your plate with the dishes you love. Your meal is weighed and charged at R350 per kilogram . Start with Calamari and grilled snoek or cob Salads Greek salad, coleslaw, carrot and pineapple salad, curry noodle salad, and potato salad with chives and bacon Vegetables Creamy spinach, sweet potato, green beans with caramelised onions, cauliflower with cheese sauce, roast potatoes, and garlic and herb baby potatoes Casseroles Oxtail stew, lamb curry, ostrich stew, and lasagne Meat Glazed honey gammon, beef tongue, roast grilled pork neck, and chicken schnitzel Cold desserts Fruit salad, jelly, ice cream with chocolate sauce, trifle, and milk tart Hot desserts Chocolate pudding and apple pie Seats are limited, so book through Quicket to reserve your place. A R100 deposit per person is required and will be deducted from your meal total on the day. Please arrive in time for the 3:00 p.m. seating. Reserved seats can be held until 3:30 p.m.; after that, they may be released and the deposit will no longer be valid. Celebrate Christmas with good food, good company, and a little festive magic by the sea. ?
